description: Dynamic Applied Regional Trade (DART) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Kiel Institute for the World Economy (IfW). Analyse the allocation effects of European and international climate policy, agricultural policy, bioeconomy policy. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Time resolution: annual. Spatial resolution: global, continents, regions, households. Software: GAMS/MPSGE. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
